# `foxglove custom-properties list`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](custom-properties.md)

```text
List custom properties

Usage: foxglove custom-properties list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render output in table, JSON, or CSV format

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json, csv]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --resource-type <RESOURCE_TYPE>
          Only properties for this resource type: device, event, session, or episode

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
